bio.text: Erik Osberg, of Wadena, is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota's 7th Congressional District in 2026; his KAXE candidate survey response lists his employment as Otter Tail County's Rural Rebound Initiative coordinator.
In his KAXE candidate survey response, Osberg said he graduated from Upsala Area Schools, played football at Hamline University, and has worked in finance, the trades and as a small business owner.
